model_output:
```sql
WITH nature_reserve AS (
  SELECT 
    park_name,
    geometry
  FROM 
    parks
  WHERE 
    ST_Within(geometry::geometry, ST_GeomFromText('[2].geo_wkt_omitted')::geometry)
    AND park_name ILIKE '%nature%'
),
max_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX((ST_Value(r.rast, n.geometry::geometry)).val) AS max_elevation
  FROM 
    nature_reserve n
  JOIN 
    public.dem_us r
  ON 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, n.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE 
    ST_Clip(r.rast, n.geometry::geometry, TRUE)
)
SELECT 
  nr.park_name AS largest_nature_reserve,
  me.max_elevation
FROM 
  nature_reserve nr,
  max_elevation me
ORDER BY 
  nr.park_name
LIMIT 1;
```
